data.long_meaning: One who is cherished and beloved. Derived from the root 'ahaba' which means 'to love'. Parents who choose Mahjooba usually hope their child will grow to embody loved one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name reminds us that every human being is beloved by Allah and that we should strive to embody His love and compassion towards others. By carrying the name "Mahjooba," one is constantly reminded to cultivate a loving and compassionate heart, both towards oneself and towards others.
